name: Afono Tier 1 commands
notes: Words chosen to look different on the muscles: silent speech cannot sense voicing (pad/bad) and blurs lip sounds (p/b/m). Two-word phrases are used where a single short word is ambiguous.

tier1_starter.why: 27 items that cover the grammar without numbers or spelling (gaze picks the target, 'click' confirms). Chosen so that no two items differ only in voicing or only in p/b/m, which surface EMG cannot see. Dropped from the full list: 'top' (inside 'stop'), 'tab' (tab/top/up differ mainly in the vowel), 'page' (p-ey onset of 'paste'), 'select' (same s/l/eh/k/t shape as 'delete'), 'done' (d-ah-n vs 'down' d-aw-n), 'bottom' (keep scroll up/down instead). Kept pairs rely on muscles EMG does see: lip rounding (close/click, open, scroll, no, show, zoom), lip closure (up, stop, open, copy, sleep, paste), lip-teeth contact (left, afono), and jaw opening (back, yes, right, hide).
tier1_starter.protocol: 27 items x 10 reps x 3 sessions = 810 prompts, about 18 min per session

grammar: scroll up | scroll down | page up | page down | top | bottom
back | next | stop | enter | undo | copy | paste | select | delete | send | tab
show | hide            (number badges on the page)

recording_protocol.prompt: item shown on screen, 1 s countdown, mouth it silently within 2 s
recording_protocol.split: sessions 1-2 train, session 3 test (never mix a session across splits)
